_doc: SM302: the mechanical half of this review's findings, so the next review re-runs the SAME check rather than reinventing it. Prose stays in the dimension files; this is only what a machine can settle. CONVENTION: `verify` exits 0 when the finding is FIXED. A finding with no `verify` is not omitted - it is reported as not-mechanical, because 'we did not automate this one' is a fact the next reviewer needs. SEEDED from the four checks quoted in SM302 itself, which are real and were run by hand during the 0.10.8 and 0.10.9 reviews; the rest of this review's findings predate the convention and are prose only.

findings.title: the security register's newest entry should be current
the bench baseline records when it was captured
the newest rehearsal is no older than the newest stable cut
findings.note: Needs the rehearsal record and the tag list compared by date - a judgement about which cut counts as stable, so it stays manual until that is written down.
